Inca Jay 30 cm
lives in the Andean mountain range of South America
Their omnivorous diet includes insects, small vertebrates, seeds, and fruits.
Male and female are identical
males are only slightly bolder or more vocal.
They sometimes use small sticks as tools to pry bugs out of tree bark.
